# Fands

> Fands is an AI implementation agency for small and mid-size businesses in the United States. It automates workflows, builds AI into the tools a business already uses, and produces content that keeps the brand in front of customers.

Fands sells implementation, not software. Clients start with a free 30-minute call, then a paid AI Readiness Audit, then fixed-price builds and a Managed AI Retainer with a monthly results review. Contact: hello@fands.io. Book a call: https://cal.com/fands/intro-call

## Services

- [AI Services for Small Businesses](https://fands.io/services): Five AI practices: strategy and audit, workflow automation and AI integrations, AI content and search visibility, AI assistants, web development.
- [AI Receptionist & Custom AI Agents](https://fands.io/services/ai-assistants): A 24/7 AI receptionist for calls, texts and chat that books appointments and hands off to a human, plus custom AI agents and apps.
- [Business Process & Lead Automation](https://fands.io/services/ai-operations): Automate invoicing, onboarding and lead follow-up with n8n, Make and Zapier, add a knowledge assistant and train your team on AI.
- [Website, E-commerce & App Development](https://fands.io/services/digital-development): Websites, online stores and web apps for small businesses, with AI chat, order automation and Shopify, Wix and WordPress integrations.
- [AI Content, AI Search (GEO) & Local SEO](https://fands.io/services/media-growth): An AI content engine, visibility in ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews, local SEO, paid media and branding for small businesses.
- [AI Readiness Audit & Managed AI Retainer](https://fands.io/services/strategy-entry): A paid AI readiness audit with process mapping, ROI estimate and a 30/60/90-day plan, then a retainer that keeps every system running.

## Process and company

- [About Fands: AI Implementation Agency](https://fands.io/about): Fands is an AI implementation agency for small and mid-size US businesses. We don’t sell software: we implement it, measure it and keep it running.
- [Contact Fands: Book a Free AI Consultation](https://fands.io/contact): Tell us where the work gets stuck. Request a workflow review or book a free 30-minute call with Fands. We reply within two business days.
- [How We Work: AI Implementation Process](https://fands.io/how-we-work): Five steps from a free call to a monthly review: AI readiness audit, strategy with a fixed quote, build and launch, measured results.

## Case studies

- [AI Case Studies for Small Businesses](https://fands.io/case-studies): Example AI engagements: invoice automation, lead follow-up automation and an AI receptionist, with the metrics we track on every project.
- [Invoice Automation for an Accounting Firm](https://fands.io/case-studies/accounting-firm-invoice-automation): Example engagement: AI reads invoices, matches vendors and purchase orders and drafts bill entries for human approval at an accounting firm.
- [Lead Follow-Up Automation for a Contractor](https://fands.io/case-studies/home-services-lead-follow-up): Example engagement: speed-to-lead replies, missed-call text-back and automatic follow-up for a home services remodeling contractor.
- [AI Receptionist for a Med Spa: Case Study](https://fands.io/case-studies/med-spa-ai-receptionist): Example engagement: an AI receptionist answers med spa calls 24/7, books appointments and hands medical questions to the front desk.

- [Your First AI Workflow Should Be Boring](https://fands.io/insights/first-workflow): A practical scorecard for choosing your first AI workflow, measuring the baseline, testing edge cases and deciding whether to expand.
